summary: Master the art of data visualization with our comprehensive training course. Design effective dashboards that transform data into actionable insights.
lede: Data visualization and dashboard design help analysts and reporting professionals turn datasets into visual reports for decision-makers. The course addresses the practical task of building dashboards around audience needs and varying data quality. Participants practice preparing data, selecting charts, planning user-focused layouts, storyboarding data narratives, aligning KPIs, and creating governance and maintenance plans.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals who are responsible for interpreting data and communicating findings to decision-makers across the enterprise.
modules: Foundations of Visual Perception and Design
Data Structuring and Preparation for Visualization
Advanced Chart Selection and IBCS Standards
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of data analysis concepts and experience working with spreadsheet software like Microsoft Excel®. No prior coding or graphic design experience is required, though familiarity with basic business metrics is recommended.
